meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Compared README three-RAG processing diagram and runtime docs against both actual AiClient loops, RuntimeAgentToolRegistry, AgentInstructionService and scoped data/trace services.

auth.review_note: Reviewed the backend skill changes and capability boundary against unchanged account/login authorization: anonymous cart/status handles cannot read accounts, saved addresses or private owner records; browser credentials do not authorize remote tools.

commerce.review_note: Cross-reviewed current-price cart paise precision, captured-INR predicate, shared idempotent VerifiedOrderService, actual-discount GST and frozen tax evidence. Order/checkout docs distinguish captured payment from saved order and preserve later browser-cart edits on retry.

content.review_note: Verified editorial profile, factual copy, approved image dimensions, module-filtered links and canonical AboutPage metadata against content guide.

foundation.review_note: Reviewed canonical media schema and existing MySQL ownership, authenticated bridge, revision-safe update and no binary change.

google-tags.review_note: Reviewed fixed Google v5 endpoint, canonical HTTPS origin, CSRF owner-only routes, bounded report projection and unavailable/quota states against integration documentation and fixtures.

http-errors.review_note: Reviewed architecture guidance; existing safe failure/HTTP status boundary unchanged by deployment-neutral developer metadata.

interface.review_note: Reviewed owner media edit details, preview alt text, search, conflict feedback, and corresponding operator documentation.

mail.review_note: Reviewed AdminController addition: metadata route only; no mail lifecycle or delivery behavior modified.

mcp-clients.review_note: Reviewed new PageSpeed integration documentation; owner Google reports are not exposed via MCP and client grants are unchanged.

media.review_note: Reviewed upload eligibility, revision hash, bounded UTF-8 metadata, row lock, exact patch, no row creation, and view/search/isolated DB tests.

operator-help.review_note: Cross-checked actual owner media edit form, authenticated CSRF route, revision-conflict message, limits and help guide.

public-mcp.review_note: Reviewed ProjectMapService route addition and canonical dispatcher; media edits are owner-only and not exposed as public tools.

remote-commerce.review_note: Reviewed narrow DatabaseService row-lock patch and password-protected remotedb action; no changes to cart/checkout methods or authority.

sales-channels.review_note: Reviewed MediaService metadata/search patch; URL, binary and usage fields used by published feeds remain unchanged.

workflow.review_note: Retained current About and PageSpeed browser jobs plus media browser test; regenerated code-driven index and maps.
